opening.argument: The video presents a political critique of the National Education Policy through a direct comparison between stated claims and depicted educational conditions. Its description says that “Large claims made about the new National Education Policy have also proved to be jumla,” while the speaker reports that “During the last year, most schools, colleges and universities were closed.” The visual reinforces that analytical structure with a split-screen graphic contrasting claim and reality alongside a National Education Policy 2020 graphic. The only requested action is to “subscribe for more videos” through the Congress party channel, a routine channel-promotion request with no connection to payment, investment, private information, or another deceptive participation flow.
